description: A React component implementation for rendering icons, supporting SVG icons, emojis, and various size configurations. It imports external icon mappings and utility functions, and exports a functional component 'Icon'.

methods.name: getIconComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate icon component based on the icon type, by checking mappings.

methods.name: isIconEmoji
methods.description: Determines if the provided icon type is an emoji icon by checking if an SVG component exists.
